bullets.id: Penjualan ritel AS Oktober naik 0,2%, sesuai konsensus, tetapi ritel di luar kendaraan naik 0,6%, di atas perkiraan 0,4%. Emas spot sempat ke $3.848,64 usai data dan ditutup Selasa di sekitar $3.853,10. Rabu pagi tekanan berlanjut: Investing.com mencatat emas spot turun 0,7% ke $3.822,03, dan Trading Economics menunjukkan harga di $3.795,89, terendah lebih dari setahun.
bullets.en: US October retail sales rose 0.2%, in line with consensus, but sales excluding autos rose 0.6%, above the 0.4% forecast. Spot gold slipped to $3,848.64 after the data and ended Tuesday near $3,853.10. The pressure continued on Wednesday morning: Investing.com showed spot gold down 0.7% at $3,822.03, and Trading Economics shows $3,795.89, the lowest in over a year.

bullets.id: Presiden Fed St. Louis Alberto Musalem menyebut ekonomi kemungkinan butuh beberapa kenaikan bunga lagi sebelum musim semi, dan John Williams dari Fed New York bilang masih ada pekerjaan untuk membawa inflasi ke 2%. Trading Economics mencatat peluang hampir 96% untuk kenaikan 25 bps Desember. Indeks dolar naik ke 103,65 dan yield 10 tahun di sekitar 5,10%. Emas turun 8,3% dalam sebulan dan sekitar 32% di bawah rekor $5.608,35.
bullets.en: St. Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem said the economy will probably need several more rate hikes before spring, and the New York Fed’s John Williams said there is more work to do to bring inflation to 2%. Trading Economics shows a nearly 96% chance of a 25 bp December hike. The dollar index rose to 103.65 and the 10-year yield sits near 5.10%. Gold is down 8.3% over the month and about 32% below its $5,608.35 record.

bullets.id: Kitco mencatat support di $3.832 lalu $3.805, dengan resistance di $3.888 dan $3.898,61. Setelah $3.800 tertembus, ANZ melihat pembelian strategis dan ritel bisa membentuk support di sekitar $3.600. Agenda: risalah rapat Fed Oktober Kamis pukul 02.00 WIB, lalu klaim pengangguran Kamis pukul 20.30 WIB.
bullets.en: Kitco lists support at $3,832 then $3,805, with resistance at $3,888 and $3,898.61. With $3,800 now broken, ANZ sees strategic and retail buying forming support around $3,600. Agenda: the minutes of the Fed’s October meeting on Wednesday at 2 p.m. ET, then jobless claims on Thursday at 8:30 a.m. ET.

bullets.id: Antam 1 gram turun tipis Rp1.000 ke Rp2.514.000, sementara buyback turun Rp6.000 ke Rp2.272.000, sehingga spread melebar ke Rp242.000 (sekitar 9,6%). Galeri24 turun Rp5.000 ke Rp2.451.000 (buyback Rp2.307.000, spread sekitar 5,9%) dan UBS turun Rp5.000 ke Rp2.475.000 (buyback Rp2.281.000, spread sekitar 7,8%).
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram price edged down Rp1,000 to Rp2,514,000, while buyback fell Rp6,000 to Rp2,272,000, widening the spread to Rp242,000 (about 9.6%). Galeri24 fell Rp5,000 to Rp2,451,000 (buyback Rp2,307,000, spread about 5.9%) and UBS fell Rp5,000 to Rp2,475,000 (buyback Rp2,281,000, spread about 7.8%).
